evals.prompt: 请为 packages/shared-services/src/api 生成模块文档，输出到对应 claudedocs/modules，并维护索引。
evals.expected_output: 生成 ai-module-spec v2 文档，YAML 包含 spec_version、read_order、detail_sections、key_files、top_risks 和 verification.commands；service 契约、测试证明点和影响范围写入正文。

evals.prompt: 请更新 packages/shared-ui/src/leaflet-image-map 的模块文档，要求按新格式整理，但不要编造排查路径。
evals.expected_output: 升级旧文档为 ai-module-spec v2，YAML 使用新 key 且只承担索引职责；复杂关系使用 Mermaid，无法确认的排查路径进入待确认项。

evals.prompt: 请给一个简单工具函数目录生成 claudedocs 文档，文档要适合 AI 快速接手修改。
evals.expected_output: 简单模块输出较短 ai-module-spec v2 文档，不强制 Mermaid 或问题排查路径；YAML 保持 25-40 行并只保留关键文件、风险摘要、验证命令和正文索引。

objective_assertions: YAML contains read_order.quick_edit, architecture, and debugging
YAML contains detail_sections for files, risks, impact, tests, and contract
YAML contains key_files with path and reason entries
YAML contains top_risks within the module complexity limit
YAML contains verification.commands and does not list full test files
YAML does not contain related_files, risk_points, change_impact, verified_by, or type contract blocks
Body contains AI 快速接手 and AI 修改守则 near the top
Body contains full verified behavior with test files, commands, and proves statements
Service modules include the full service-specific contract in 当前实现契约
Unconfirmed debugging paths are not invented and appear in 待确认项
